summary.headline: FY26 record revenue of INR 550 crore (+10.5% YoY) and EBITDA of INR 71.9 crore, with gross margin at a record 13.2%.
summary.overview: Management reported FY26 as the strongest year in company history, with revenue up 10.5% YoY to INR 550 crore and EBITDA up 60.9%, while PAT rose 72.3%. Q4 revenue was a record INR 139 crore (+6.9% YoY) with EBITDA margin of 11.2%, below the full-year level. Operating cash flow and net cash rose to INR 127.3 crore, and the Board recommended a dividend of INR 8 per share. Management reiterated guidance for sustained double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth, while most of the call went to AI-disruption questions, share price, buyback and disclosure of guidance.

segments.name: Transportation (automotive and rail)
segments.commentary: Revenue de-grew 1% in FY26 after exits of Tier-1 and Tier-2 clients across India, Europe and the US; OEM growth has not yet reached the targeted 10-30%. Management says growth is now visible and the vertical could scale 5x-10x.

segments.name: Industrial / mechanical engineering
segments.commentary: Mechanical engineering is about 50% of revenue; management describes the legacy business as the core and bread-and-butter. No segment figures were given.

segments.name: Software / digital and AI
segments.commentary: Software is about 50% of revenue. Management is investing in digital and AI capabilities with dedicated budgets, and a digital AI lab in Chennai is planned within a couple of months.

segments.name: Geography
segments.commentary: About 70% of revenue from North America and 30% from Europe on an annual basis; management says there are zero India clients.

guidance_outlook: Management reiterated guidance for sustained double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth; it did not give a specific percentage on the call.
Management said 95-98% of FY27 revenue will come from existing clients, based on budgets from the 75 active clients.
Management said it expects better annual performance than FY26 on both top line and bottom line, and higher cash reserves.
Management aspires to 20-30% revenue growth a year and an EBITDA margin in the high teens; it said April trends were encouraging but gave no firm commitment.
Client count is targeted to fall from 75 to about 50 in the next couple of quarters.
Embedded/SDV work is expected to be 18-30% of revenue in the next couple of years.
capex_capacity: Capex of about INR 25 crore over the next two years for existing clients, mainly lab set-up; excludes any large new deal, which would go to the Board.
Digital AI lab in Chennai to be set up in the next couple of months.
Non-India headcount about 125 employees; plan to raise it to 200-300 over the next few years.
Total headcount 2,485 at March 31, 2026, roughly stable at around 2,500 over four years.
demand_pricing: Revenue recognition: about 88-90% time-and-material (hours based); the balance is fixed-price.
Top 25 clients are 88% of revenue, up from 80% when revenue was INR 250 crore.
Client count has fallen from 250 to 75 over four years; management says the exit phase is over and no further exits are planned.
Over the last 12 months, net six new clients were added; these are at an early stage with MSAs signed and billing started.
Management says no client has asked to renegotiate contracts on AI productivity grounds, and no current contracts are under renegotiation.

qa_highlights.question: Why has the share price kept falling despite good results, and is management aware?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is working on investor relations and expects to show improvement soon, while it cannot control market reactions.

qa_highlights.question: Will Anthropic Claude and AI tools affect the business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no impact so far on engineering services, which it says differ from IT and BPO work; it will disclose if that changes.

qa_highlights.question: Why not a large share buyback given about INR 125 crore net cash and a market cap of about INR 550 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Board is actively considering a buyback and the price is attractive, with no decision announced.

qa_highlights.question: Why did the transportation segment de-grow and when will it turn?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue de-grew 1% due to the exit of Tier-1/Tier-2 clients and a slower-than-expected OEM ramp amid the auto slowdown; management says momentum is now visible.

qa_highlights.question: Can high-teens margins and revenue growth be expected in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is committing only to double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth; it cited April trends and capex tailwinds as supportive.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Q4 EBITDA margin decline, and why did headcount rise?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q4 was a good quarter and it focuses on annual figures; some quarters see investment or onboarding timing differences. It said there are no year-end bonuses.

risks_watch: AI disruption: management says there is no impact yet, but it is monitoring developments and has bought AI licences to test productivity gains that could reduce billable hours.
Transportation/auto vertical: revenue de-grew 1% in FY26 and needs to turn for the three-vertical growth model to work.
Q4 EBITDA margin of 11.2% versus 13.2% for the full year; quarterly volatility from investment timing.
Client concentration: top 25 clients at 88% of revenue, with the client count being reduced to about 50.
Currency: management could not give constant-currency growth on the call; IR (E&Y) to provide it. The rupee depreciation effect is not quantified.
Capital allocation: buyback under Board consideration, no decision yet; dividend raised to INR 8.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on FY26 results and multi-year outlook, but defensive and evasive on AI-disruption questions, constant-currency growth and the stock price. Management declined to give a specific FY27 growth percentage and repeatedly fell back on "double-digit".
key_quotes: FY26 has been the strongest year in our history.
We believe we have everything in front of us today to deliver double-digit EBITDA and revenue growth.
We have not seen that yet.
So far, we have not seen our customers getting affected.
